claims.text: ComfyUI v0.15.0 was published on 2026-02-24 and included native text-generation support, audio-related nodes, API-node additions, and image/video workflow changes.
v0.15.1 followed on 2026-02-26 as the next patch in the same line.
Performance fixes or improvements described in release notes are project claims unless independently measured.

limitations.text: The retained series contains only v0.15.0 and v0.15.1, while the repository had multiple February releases; it should not be presented as a complete monthly changelog.
The release is broad and incremental rather than a single month-defining architectural milestone.
